You check whether a knowledge-base article answers a support ticket for a clinical practice-management product. Set answers_ticket to true only if following the article would resolve what the ticket actually asks. An article about a related task does not answer it: an article on placing an order does not answer a question about cancelling one. Give the reason in one sentence.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: grounding.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "Whether the best-matching article actually answers the ticket.", "properties": {"answers_ticket": {"title": "Answers Ticket", "type": "boolean"}, "reason": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["answers_ticket", "reason"], "title": "grounding", "type": "object"}

Article id: configure-provider-calendar
Article: Update provider working hours and calendar blocks
To keep appointment slots accurate, you can update regular working hours and add one-time calendar blocks for meetings or time off. 

1. Go to **Settings > Scheduling > Provider Hours**.
2. Select the target clinician from the **Provider** dropdown menu.
3. Adjust the weekly schedule by entering start and end times, or check **Day Off** for non-working days.
4. To block specific dates, click **Add Block**, choose your start and end timestamps, and select a reason from the category list.
5. Click **Save Changes** at the bottom of the page.

### Limits and Conditions
Changes apply immediately to future scheduling slots. Past appointments remain unaffected, and you cannot overlap a working-hours shift with an existing confirmed appointment.

### Troubleshooting
If the calendar still displays incorrect availability, clear your browser cache and verify that no conflicting group-schedule overrides are active under **Settings > Scheduling > Facility Hours**. If issues persist, ensure the provider's primary time zone matches your clinic's main location setting.

Ticket:
Online booking rules resetting on their own

This online scheduling configuration is driving me crazy. We are trying to let patients book routine slots through the web portal, but every time I save the settings, it opens up every single appointment type for all of our providers instead of just the ones we selected. I have tried toggling the restrictions off and on three different times, and it keeps resetting itself. Can someone please look at our portal rules and fix whatever is overriding my changes?
